icons.name: Coliseum
icons.prompt:
The two attached images (ref_shop.png, ref_tavern.png) are existing menu icons from a fantasy game. Match their art style exactly: bold hand-inked black outlines of varying weight, mostly white/light grey fill with subtle grey shading, a very limited warm accent tint, tattoo-flash / woodcut illustration feel, a single chunky centred object, no text.

Subject: a menu icon for the game's COLISEUM (PvP arena). Draw a single solid, compact, chunky object: a round stone Roman-style coliseum arena building seen from a slight three-quarter front view, with two tiers of arches, and a small pennant flag on top. The object must be solid and filled (not thin line art), occupying about 75% of the canvas, centred.

Background: flat pure white (#FFFFFF), no shadow on the ground, no border, no vignette, no frame. Square 1024x1024.
icons.generator: codex-cli 0.158.0 (codex exec --enable image_generation), style references menu/shop.webp and menu/tavern.webp at 256px
icons.postProcessing: Border flood-fill of near-white pixels (min RGB >= 232) removed the white background, 1px grow + 1.2px Gaussian feather on alpha, cropped to the subject, centred on a square canvas with the subject at 76% of the side, LANCZOS downscale to 16/24/32/48/64/128/256 webp (q92). originals/menu/coliseum.png keeps the white-background 1024px render; originals/menu/coliseum.webp is the cropped cutout.
icons.replaces: 2026-02-03 LoRA v2 render whose background removal erased almost every pixel (finding 96)

icons.name: Clan
icons.prompt: heraldic kite shield with a stylised wolf-head emblem and a red swallow-tailed banner on a short pole behind it
icons.codexSheetPrompt:
The three attached images (ref_shop.png, ref_tavern.png, ref_coliseum.png) are existing menu icons from a fantasy game. Match their art style exactly: bold hand-inked black outlines of varying weight, mostly white/light grey fill with subtle grey shading, a very limited warm accent tint (one small accent colour per icon), tattoo-flash / woodcut illustration feel, a single chunky centred object, no text, no letters.

Generate ONE landscape 1536x1024 image containing THREE separate icons in a row, each centred in its own 512px-wide column, with wide plain white gaps between them. They must not touch or overlap.

- LEFT icon "Clan": a heraldic kite shield with a hanging swallow-tailed banner behind it on a short pole, the shield bearing a simple bold emblem (a stylised wolf head), red accent on the banner.
- MIDDLE icon "Looking for group": a wooden quest-notice board on two posts with three pinned paper notices (blank, no writing) and a small hand-bell hanging from the side, warm wood accent.
- RIGHT icon "Requests": a folded letter envelope with a large round red wax seal, a small curled scroll tucked behind it.

Each object must be SOLID and chunky (not thin line art), filling about 75% of its column's width, vertically centred.

Background: flat pure white (#FFFFFF) everywhere, no shadow on the ground, no border, no vignette, no frame.

Use the image generation tool exactly ONCE. Do not retry or make variations. Save the generated image as candidate.png in the current directory.
icons.generator: codex-cli 0.158.0 (codex exec --enable image_generation, thread 01a0ee77-6de4-7ca1-b816-77a4476feaaf), one generation producing the three Social Hub tab icons in a row; this is the left icon. Style references menu/shop, menu/tavern, menu/coliseum at 256px
icons.postProcessing: Whole sheet cut out (border-connected near-white removed, min RGB >= 225, 1px grow + 1.2px Gaussian feather), connected components assigned to icons by centroid x, each icon cropped and centred on a square canvas with its larger side at 78%, LANCZOS downscale to 16/24/32/48/64/128/256 webp (q92). originals/menu/<id>.png is the 1024 white-background render; originals/menu/<id>.webp is the cutout.
